visibilityReview: The remaining 52 raw state fields have source renderer/hint/caller classifications. sourceDerivedOnly authorizes only the named strict derived surfaces, never a raw nested copy; internalBookkeeping and unsupportedContext are distinct from private information. This classification does not register rule-engine support or establish whole coverage GO.

dynamicPublicFieldEvidence.source: Source applyExpansionCard/September card owner flags; expansionSquareMarks displays taboo square marker, excluding private pieceId.
dynamicPublicFieldEvidence.meaning: Public acquired-card effects, represented as known owner flags; these are created lazily and absent from resetGame defaults.

ownPlanEvidence: canViewFreeMovePlans + currentFreeMoveTraceSets(main72535..72555): owner known ordered plans, opponent invisible; random plan/piece IDs excluded.
nestedVisibilityReview: Nested values are projected through strict source-derived piece/status/board/card/deathmatch schemas. Absolute clocks, opaque IDs, private piece state and future random choices are not authorized by a top-level classification. Unsupported timed/online/callback contexts retain explicit support boundaries.
privateNestedKeyGuard: Strict source value/status/selection schemas reject unreviewed nested keys. Raw identity/hiddenFrom/RNG keys and plural private piece/preview IDs are guarded; trolley windowId is execution-only. This is a boundary guard, not completion of remaining renderer visibility audit.

selectedScope.meaning: Actual frozen createPieceElement classes, badges and accessible labels compared for both online-player viewers. Source per-surface wrapper gates are preserved. This selected scope is not a proof of every pending state family.

trolley.meaning: Only the two visible bundle labels and lever choice are public. Random/time window ID is private execution/staleness binding and never an observation or public intent feature; exact Action retains it.

deathmatch.context: 8x8 normal/chaos/grand local explicit decisions. Local notices are visible independent of viewer color; online role guards are outside this projection context.
deathmatch.meaning: deathmatchStatus.active is the active extension flag; warning is source local warning eligibility in play mode with no progress this turn and 1..2 remaining half-turns. It does not predict actual termination and does not claim current DOM toast/status presence.
deathmatch.private: No raw elapsed counter, startedAt, warningKey, Date/server anchors, or online account role is copied.
deathmatch.lifetime: Source toast show class expires after1900ms, status persists until setStatus overwrite, and private notice-key dedup suppresses re-delivery. Snapshot-derived warning preserves public rule warning meaning rather than external DOM history.

New nested keys are rejected rather than treated as visibility evidence.
publicValueEvidence.limits: Array limits are explicit 8x8 observation resource boundaries; raw full state/replay stays lossless outside neural inputs.

coverage.pendingFieldDisposition: 52-field source visibility audit classified current rendered/hint meanings versus internal/private/presentation/unsupported slices; no active source family is promoted by metadata. Whole implementation remains NO_GO until execution/chance/default-mode gates close.
unsupportedContexts: real-time DOM animation, wall-clock draft timeout and beta optimistic previews
coverage.traceVersion: accelerate-public-trace-v1 patch envelope retained: each complete frame independently carries observation-v2/projection policy SHA and JCS informationStateKey
coverage.numericSemantics: Source glyph counts retain the complete accessible aria value where available; only source clamps are applied. Integer JSON numerics accept integral finite floats under the shared safe-integer JCS boundary.

accelerationTrail.rawDisposition: Mixed display coordinates and hidden-view ownership; raw trail is not universally public.

brilliantMove.rawDisposition: Unused legacy state normalization/reset slot, not a private-information classification inferred from its name.

cardBanIds.rawDisposition: Pool exclusion bookkeeping plus editor configuration. No dedicated ban-list renderer was found in the complete references.
cardBanIds.publicMeaning: An applied public RULE already identifies its exclusion; editor-supplied bans are configuration, not a player hand.

chainBonds.rawDisposition: Opaque bond ID and aId/bId references remain internal; full raw bond is not public.

chaosNoCaptureUntilHalfTurn.rawDisposition: Absolute half-turn expiry is rule bookkeeping; do not fabricate a badge or expose the raw deadline.
chaosNoCaptureUntilHalfTurn.publicMeaning: Actual visible lock class where source elects to show it, and player legal destination hints.

clonedPassiveCards.rawDisposition: Keys combine source color and source instance identity. Source bounds this internal ledger to 64; it is not a list of publicly rendered cards.
clonedPassiveCards.publicMeaning: The public passive application/effect and its log, not the dedup ledger.

collapsePending.rawDisposition: Queued owner color and settlement phase are not unconditionally copied.
collapsePending.publicMeaning: The pending collapse ring as meteor markers.

coronation.rawDisposition: Color flag and protection startTurn/previousProtected bookkeeping are separate from the visible protected trait.
coronation.publicMeaning: Public known card effect and visible queen protection/status.

crownRule.rawDisposition: Holder IDs, token identity and pending reconciliation references are internal; hidden holders are not independently revealed.
crownRule.publicMeaning: Visible ground crown, visible crown bearer and accessible held-move count.

deathmatch.rawDisposition: startedAtTurn, halfTurnsSinceProgress, progressThisTurn and warning dedup keys must not be copied wholesale.
deathmatch.publicMeaning: Active public extension and its current-turn no-progress end-warning meaning; toast/status text is not a raw countdown.

delayedHazards.rawDisposition: casterId, triggerAfter and internal queue identities are not displayed as raw nested values.
delayedHazards.publicMeaning: Displayed meteor/lightning cells and source impact/history after settlement.

diceLocks.rawDisposition: Raw lock object is a per-color execution window, not an arbitrary nested public object.
diceLocks.publicMeaning: Visible lock state and declared roll/type-duration public message.

draftBalance.rawDisposition: Owner-known offer statistic and opponent-private latent chance input.
draftBalance.publicMeaning: White can derive its own average from its known offered cards. Black does not receive the latent mean.

draftClock.rawDisposition: Server anchors/Date starts are transport timing; treating the complete clock as private would be wrong.
draftClock.publicMeaning: Visible remaining draft time in the timed-game context.

draftResumeTurn.rawDisposition: Internal phase continuation color. Absence of a dedicated renderer does not make the color intrinsically secret.
draftResumeTurn.publicMeaning: Public next turn after draft completion; earlier action/history may identify the interrupted actor.

drawOffer.rawDisposition: Raw userId/cooldown/room transport is not a neural input.
drawOffer.publicMeaning: Public offer role, accept/reject affordance and completed result in online rooms.

enPassant.rawDisposition: Raw captured coordinates/auxiliary rights can contain latent board facts and are not universally exposed.

encouragement.rawDisposition: Internal enable flag/royal or campfire/outpost rule helpers are not opaque plans.
encouragement.publicMeaning: Displayed encouraged cells and known public active effect.

exhaustion.rawDisposition: Current pieceId and streak are rule bookkeeping; own move history may infer them, but hidden opponent streaks must not be copied.

feudalContracts.rawDisposition: pawnId/guardianId/contract ID and private endpoint coordinates remain internal.
feudalContracts.publicMeaning: Visible pawn contract badge including the source-revealed guardian type, even if the guardian itself is hidden.

firstMoveCardsForced.rawDisposition: Internal once-only lifecycle flag; not a separate player decision or hidden offer.

firstMoveUndo.rawDisposition: First-move auto-card rollback snapshot. Its non-null form copies the board, captures, selection and internal Set state; neither the object nor its null lifecycle sentinel is a player-visible surface.
firstMoveUndo.publicMeaning: Only the resulting visible board, used card, history and legal choices are projected after the automatic opening resolves.

freeMoveCaptureLock.rawDisposition: Raw free-move lifecycle flag and secret premove plans are separate; opponent plans remain private.
freeMoveCaptureLock.publicMeaning: Source-visible capture lock and selectable quiet destinations.

gomokuVictoryCells.rawDisposition: Coordinates are display meaning; no private piece identity is needed.

idolEncoreUsedByPiece.rawDisposition: Internal once-per-color-turn ledger; its name does not describe actual piece-ID storage.

initiative.rawDisposition: Raw by/startTurn/limit object is not a public timestamp payload.

judgmentExiles.rawDisposition: Full saved piece, private traits, opaque exile ID and ID-seeded future return destination remain hidden/internal.

lastTurnCaptures.rawDisposition: Internal previous-turn captured-ID Set, not a public counter.

magicGirlSurgeRefreshPending.publicMeaning: Visible awakened magic-girl/remembered movement status and its next actual action consequences.

necromancy.rawDisposition: Root piece IDs, originalType/revivedType copies and createdAt are execution records, not raw public objects.

overwhelm.rawDisposition: Per-color effect flag is not a secret plan, but no arbitrary nested state is rendered.
overwhelm.publicMeaning: Public known applied effect and legal-action/capture consequences.

palaces.rawDisposition: Full owner/rule object is distinct from the neutral marker surface.

pendingGales.rawDisposition: Queue IDs, exact absolute triggerTurn and raw entry ownership are not independently displayed as nested values.

pendingRuleTickets.rawDisposition: Opaque ticket ID/absolute owner clock remain internal.

platformRule.rawDisposition: Raw turn schedule and future random-spawn context are not player inputs.

portalRule.rawDisposition: Raw helper state and source execution flags are separate from the public neutral marker.

temporaryQueens.rawDisposition: Root IDs/createdAt are lifecycle references; public count is the piece scalar actually rendered.

timeIsMineSequence.rawDisposition: Date start and color latch control asynchronous settlement; erasing ID Sets are internal/presentation, not unconditionally public.

turnCaptures.rawDisposition: Internal captured-piece-ID Set, not an integer count or independently rendered library.

ultimatum.rawDisposition: Raw deadline, tracked movements and reference identity are not copied as public nested data.
